evals.prompt: Right, apply those three fixes to the planner. C14 and C15 on the CERV_OPS sheet plus the SUM on the summary tab. The sheet is protected, don't leave it unlocked.

evals.prompt: Some of the dropdowns in the events sheet have stopped working. Not all of them - it's like every third row is just a plain cell now.
evals.expected_output: repair mode, diagnosis. Recognises the fragmented data-validation signature: row insertion shatters a contiguous sqref into single-row areas so the rule holds on some rows and not others, with nothing erroring because a missing dropdown looks like an empty cell. scan reports areas and single_row_areas per rule.
